retainedReference.title: Palace of Fontainebleau, principal exterior and horseshoe stairs

pictures.author: Harmonia Amanda
pictures.observed: Actually inspected the 1280px photo: pale limestone facade, rusticated base, crossed pale window sashes, blue-gray steep roof with framed pedimented dormers, large brick chimneys and a central upper pavilion. Distinct double horseshoe stairs curve out from the wall with stone balustrades and an arched central lower entrance; the upper landing meets a separate higher door. Sculpture, coats of arms, inscription and tree planters should be omitted or abstracted.

pictures.author: David Jouas
pictures.observed: Actually inspected the 1280px courtyard panorama: long pale gallery with repeating open ground arcade, first-floor windows, balustrade course and continuous dormers/chimneys; perpendicular pale two-level range with dark hipped roof and shaped central dormer. Two opposed straight stairs meet a raised central entrance; water-side courtyard edge remains open. No copied pixels, lettering, figures or flags.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Principal exterior of the Palace of Fontainebleau, including the mapped White Horse courtyard ranges/north range, central pavilion and two curved horseshoe stair flights, Gallery of Francis I/Cour de la Fontaine ranges, eastern oval court/chapel and northeast service court ranges. Pale masonry, crossed casements, steep slate roofs/dormers and brick chimneys. Open courtyards and independent buildings remain. No furnished rooms, copied crests/inscriptions/sculpture, flags, gardens, fountain sculpture or peripheral stable/administration buildings.
